nodes.norm_label: phase order: shell -> ai -> calendar -> canvas -> materials -> grades -> focus -> polish
nodes.rationale: User's choice; phases reordered from original roadmap, nothing dropped (old->new mapping kept).

nodes.label: Commit and push every important change to main; keep ROADMAP current
nodes.norm_label: commit and push every important change to main; keep roadmap current

nodes.label: SaaS step (later)
nodes.rationale: Sign-up, landing page, Stripe, Resend, Canvas OAuth, two-way GCal, auto time-blocking; don't pull in unless asked. RLS from day one keeps it additive.

nodes.label: NDJSON streaming protocol (think, text, propose, cards, error)
nodes.norm_label: ndjson streaming protocol (think, text, propose, cards, error)

nodes.label: Calendar + class-week grounding in prompt
nodes.rationale: Explicit date lines keep the model correct about dates and class times; do not remove.

nodes.label: Canvas descriptions labeled untrusted data
nodes.rationale: Sanitized Canvas assignment descriptions enter AI context as data, not instructions (prompt-injection defense).

nodes.label: Do-not-change rules (§19, §26)
nodes.rationale: AI changes only via confirm cards; free OpenRouter chain + reasoning rule + grounding; gooey + in sidebar; metal only on AI; floating Settings; no plaintext Canvas token; no SaaS complexity unless asked.

nodes.label: OpenRouter free models fallback chain (Nemotron 3 Super -> Qwen 3.8 27B -> Nemotron 3 Ultra)
nodes.norm_label: openrouter free models fallback chain (nemotron 3 super -> qwen 3.8 27b -> nemotron 3 ultra)
nodes.rationale: Cost: user rejected paid Anthropic key; OpenAI-compatible config makes provider a config change. Gemma dropped for frequent 429. Free providers may log prompts.

nodes.label: Reasoning off by default, auto for tutoring, Think toggle
nodes.norm_label: reasoning off by default, auto for tutoring, think toggle
nodes.rationale: Always-on reasoning gave ~15s to first word; off gives ~0.5s. needsThinking() auto-enables for tutoring or >280 chars, never for planner edits.

nodes.label: Rejected: paid Anthropic API / NVIDIA NIM / Bytez

nodes.rationale: Cost

nodes.label: Rejected: reasoning always on

nodes.label: RLS on every table (user_id default auth.uid())
nodes.norm_label: rls on every table (user_id default auth.uid())
nodes.rationale: Single user now, but keeps the SaaS step additive rather than a rewrite.

nodes.label: Saved chat history (/chat)
nodes.rationale: Reverses the earlier session-only chat decision; chats table (migration 0004).
